main.py_introduction: hi welcome to the Wordle Bot 💥
this bot will literally DO the wordle for YOU >:O
juuust type in your word (doesnt have to be a real word) and the bot will do the rest!!
make sure you format the colours correctly (G for green, Y for yellow, and X for gray) and put em all together like this: gxyxx
oh btw FIVE letter words only!!
dont forget press Ctrl+C to exit the bot at any time 💥💥💥💥
